w: At 10.00 a.m., Swamishri performed the foundation stone laying ceremony for an Industrial Training Institute (I.T.I.) complex at the K.G. Pithawala Vidyalaya.

On arriving in Karamkhal, Swamishri was welcomed by the tribal youth devotees with a traditional dance. Swamishri responded to their rhythm and pulse of devotion by joining them in striking a brass dish with a stick. Swamishri's participation enthused the crowd further. Swamishri then performed the murti-pratishtha of Akshar Purushottam Maharaj, Radha Krishna Dev and Guru parampara. It was the opening of the ninth Swaminarayan Mandir in the tribal area of Selvas.

At 11.00 p.m. Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of Shri Akshar Purushottam Maharaj, Shri Radha Krishna Dev, Guru Parampara, Shri Hanumanji and Shri Ganapatiji for the hari mandir in Southend-on-Sea. A beautiful annakut was arranged before the deities and thereafter Swamishri performed the pratishtha arti. The event concluded with Swamishri’ s blessings.

At 6.30 p.m. The volunteers of BAPS Children’s activities performed a drama ‘Andehri nagari and gandu raja.’ A slide show on Yogiji Maharaj was screened. Then a dance on the kirtan ‘Ho Swami Guruhari chho tame’ was performed by children. After every verse of the bhajan personal incidents were narrated by children with reference to Swamishri as a friend, inspirer and consolidator of niyam-dharma and devotion. Finally Swamishri blessed the assembly.
During the meetings, a child came to Pramukh Swami Maharaj. Opening the top button of his shirt and holding out the vest that could be seen inside, he said, "Bapa! Sign here for me."
Swamishri took the pen in his hand, but the sadhus standing around said, "Children imitate each other. If you write for one, many will come to you."

Swamishri could not disappoint the child. He did not sign, but quickly drew two or three lines. This too was a wonderful keepsake. Swamishri is always concerned for children. So that children's feelings do not wither and they keep progressing in satsang, Swamishri responds favourably even to their whimsical wishes. Then why would children not become Swamishri's own?!

w: In the morning, Pramukh Swami Maharaj performed the murti pratishtha of the marble images for the mandir in Southend-on-Sea. The ceremony took place at BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, London. Ghanshyamcharan Swami performed the mahapuja vidhi. Swamishri completed the murti pratishtha rituals and offered the arti. A beautiful annakut was prepared by the devotees of Southend-on-Sea, Wickford and Colchester.

In his blessings, Swamishri talked of how one should regularly go to the Mandir and also that by improving one’s life, attain happiness and build a mandir in one’s heart for God to reside in. Some 180 devotees from the Mandal participated in the ceremonies.

At 10.30 am Swamishri’s chartered plane departed from Sardar Patel International Airport, Ahmedabad, towards Nairobi the capital of Kenya. Swamishri was accompanied by Ishwarcharan Swami, Viveksagar Swami, Anandswarup Swami, Yogicharan Swami, Dharmacharan Swami, Krishnavallabh Swami, Narayancharan Swami, Yogismaran Swami and Shri Subhashbhai Patel. After a journey of 3,119 miles the plane landed at Jomo Kenyatta International airport at 2.40 pm (Kenya Standard Time or 5.10 pm IST). Swamishri was welcomed by the Deputy High Commissioner of India Shri Shukla, Bhaktavatsal Swami, Mahendrabhai Barrister (Chairman of East Africa Satsang), Harshadbhai Rana, Arvindbhai Saheb (President of Nairobi Mandal), Kiranbhai Patel and others. Swamishri arrived at the BAPS mandir at 3.25 pm. Children and devotees welcomed Swamishri with ‘jais’. After Thakorji’s darshan Swamishri addressed the gathering, “Because of your love and sentiments we have come and are having Thakorji’s darshan, darshan of sadhus residing here and your darshan. The festivals in Nairobi, Kampala, Dar-es-salaam and Mombasa will be celebrated well. So many have done austerities, which reflect your profound feelings and bhakti. In India, too, devotees perform fasts and pilgrimages, and sing dhun with the same deep feelings that (Swami’s) health remains well. May Maharaj grant all those who have fasted with inner strength and more bhakti.” At 4.15 pm Swamishri retired to rest. At 7.00 pm Swamishri woke up and engaged himself in reading and writing letters.
Pramukh Swami Maharaj met a spiritual seeker. He had endured a great deal physically and had great endurance too, yet, losing heart at times, he said, "I suffer a lot."

Swamishri immediately said, "Shastriji Maharaj and Yogi Bapa are with us; Maharaj is with us. Suffering has come to everyone. Suffering came even to the sadhus and paramhansas. Everyone has endured it, so whatever has come by Maharaj's will, accept it as His will and bear it. It is natural to feel a little in the mind. It is also natural that thoughts come, but accept what is and keep peace. Listen to the divine episodes of God. Since there is a body, happiness and sorrow keep coming, but God has been so compassionate that we can move about a little. Keep up your strength. I too am praying. It has been sent by Maharaj, so bear it. Do not think anything else. Do not be sad. Even the very great have suffered. Believe that whatever happens must be for our good. Do not get tired of suffering. People have such suffering that they have to lie in hospital for years, fifteen or twenty years. Compared with that, it is good that you can move about and see. So accept it as God's will."

ds.t: Seva for God is for the ultimate good
w: Shrenikbhai Trivedi had come from Ahmedabad for darshan. He had provided a special kind of chemical to stop clouds of dust from rising. When it is sprinkled, a thin layer forms over the dust. Pramukh Swami Maharaj was pleased with this seva of his. As a spiritual seeker he said to Swamishri, "Bapa! We work for our stomachs, but bless us that the ultimate good is achieved."
Swamishri said, "The seva and satsang you do for God are not for the stomach but for the ultimate good."

w: Shrenikbhai Trivedi had come from Ahmedabad for darshan. He had given a special chemical to stop clouds of dust rising; when sprayed, it forms a thin layer over the dust. Swamishri was pleased with this seva. In the spirit of a seeker he said to Swamishri, "Bapa! We work to fill our stomachs, but please bless us so that our ultimate good is done."
Swamishri said, "The seva and satsang you do for God is not for the stomach. It is for the ultimate good."

In the meeting room, a prominent lawyer from Madhya Pradesh came to meet Mahant Swami Maharaj. Because of a misunderstanding, he had been opposing us for the last twenty years. When the sadhus were going to meet him to clear up the misunderstanding, Swamishri had blessed them, saying, "There will be a 180 percent change." And those blessings had borne fruit 180 percent.

As soon as Swamishri came into the meeting room and sat on his chair, the lawyer fell at Swamishri's feet and began to say, "Forgive me, I made a mistake... forgive me..." As he said this, his eyes filled with tears.
Consoling him, Swamishri began to say, "No, if this had not happened, how would this association (with Bhagwan Swaminarayan and the great sadhu) have come about?"
He felt a little relieved. Swamishri and the sadhus asked him to sit on a chair, but he said, "No, this is fine here." At Swamishri's feet he was finding supreme peace.
Brahmviharidas Swami reminded him, "You used to say, didn't you, 'Do something so that I am accepted into your satsang!' So today the guru has accepted you; there is nothing greater than this..."
Choked with emotion, the lawyer kept saying again and again, "Keep your grace on me and on my family..." He felt deep sorrow for having opposed such a supremely holy sadhu.
Removing his embarrassment, Swamishri said, "That was a sweet quarrel... Now you have changed; there are no words to honour you."

With every word of Swamishri he melted more and more. Swamishri's loving words were turning him into a devotee. Finally he surrendered completely at Swamishri's feet. Accepting satsang, he received a mala from Swamishri's hands. Again asking forgiveness and praying for Swamishri to keep his glance on him and his family, he took his leave.
"Annam matha bhale name re ji re, annam matha bhale name..." (let the heads that never bowed now bow). Today one more head that never bowed bowed down.
